plan.title: Cancel line-item addition in saved draft

steps.note: Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the additional configuration required by the case.
Open the Events list to reach saved drafts.
Verify the events list rendered successfully.
Open the Drafts tab containing the saved eRFX draft.
Open the first saved draft available in the Drafts list.
Record the draft's current line-item count before making unsaved changes.
Open the Manage Line Items window.

args.label: Search and add line items using product name

steps.note: Select the product specified by the case.
Enter the temporary quantity for the unsaved line item.
Enter the temporary price for the unsaved line item.
Cancel the Manage Line Items changes instead of saving them.
Verify that cancelling closes the Manage Line Items window.
Verify that the saved draft's line-item count did not change.
Check the case's expected final state that the draft shows zero line items.
